title: C7 node-gate rationale
description: The node-gate model response (spec §3.1). The node-gate recommendation is computed DETERMINISTICALLY by the control plane (gating.node_gate) from the leaf's review + intent-review + spec-validate verdicts (#987); the model contributes ONLY a short `rationale`. The `recommendation` field was removed from this schema (#1009) because the control plane ignored it — embedding the enum on every node-gate round was wasted tokens. The tree-gate is a pure-Python computation and emits no model round.

rationale.description: One or two sentences explaining the (Python-computed) recommendation, grounded in the underlying review/intent/spec-validate findings. This is the ONLY model judgment the node-gate consumes (spec §3.1).
